description: Fields whose absence (null / empty) is treated as a defect rather than a true negative. A null value on a high-severity field strongly suggests the extraction should be revisited.

fields.reason: Gender is almost always inferable from pronouns in the judgment.
A neutral citation is always present in the source header; empty means extraction failed.
Action number is present in the source header.
Judgment date is present in the source header.
Overall severity category is usually stated or inferable when injuries exist.
fields.expected: Non-serious injury | Serious injury | Substantial injury | Gross disability | Disaster

fields.reason: A personal-injury judgment should yield at least one injury.
A PSLA-bearing personal-injury judgment should yield at least one loss of amenity.
Age at accident is often stated or derivable from dates.
Occupation before the accident is usually stated.
PSLA amount is expected unless the case is not a PSLA award.
